column9: unit as the household reported it
column10: harmonized market-survey unit; blank where none applies
column11: quantity reported, in the unit named by pull_nsu_unit

column13: grams (or mL) per unit for this household's row

column16: how this row got its grams, or why it did not
column17: 1 = this row has a gram figure
column18: 0 matched or standard-unit; 1-3 a borrowed rung; missing if unconverted

column20: 1 = no computable unit value on this row (e_h or q_h absent)
column21: weighings behind cf_h, at the level used; missing off conv_path 2
column22: 1 = fewer than 3 weighings behind the estimate; treat as uncertain
column23: hetero-blind: grams in one unit of this NSU, cell pooled across hetero-groups
column24: hetero-blind: q_h * cf_h_blind -- the no-price-matching counterfactual
column25: hetero-blind: dimension of cf_h_blind (1 = g, 2 = mL)
column26: hetero-blind rung: 1 cell pooled, 2 province, 3 regional (never 0)
column27: hetero-blind: how this row got its grams, or why it did not
column29: 1 = the hetero-blind ladder produced grams for this row
